purpose: Read-only metadata snapshot, not a reset or bootstrap script

tables.name: fan_visits
tables.description: INTERNAL: one visit per account per Korea-calendar day; profile FK cascades on account removal. Server-only access.

tables.name: api_rate_limits
tables.description: INTERNAL: server-only request windows; subject_hash is not a raw address. RLS deny-by-default is intentional.

tables.name: arte_musical_application_period
tables.description: ACTIVE: unique musical_name with public booking start/end timestamps; settings reference this key.

tables.name: arte_musical_tickets
tables.description: LEGACY-COMPATIBLE: historical tickets still used by owner history, ticket display, profile sync and fan XP. Do not delete or renumber.

tables.name: bookings
tables.description: RETIRED: unused predecessor booking model. Retained with seat_status dependencies; not part of account booking history.

tables.name: dead_poets_society_bookings
tables.description: ACTIVE: dead-poets-society reservations. Existing IDs, seats and owner links are retained.

tables.name: performance_settings
tables.description: ACTIVE: public performance overrides; musical_id references booking-period musical_name. Admin-only writes.

tables.name: presale_access_keys
tables.description: RETIRED: historical code records retained. Current booking uses profiles.is_presale_user; code validation HTTP endpoint returns 410.

tables.name: profiles
tables.description: ACTIVE: one-to-one auth.users profile, completed identity and DB-managed admin/presale flags. Browser cannot update role flags.

tables.name: rent_bookings
tables.description: ACTIVE: rent reservations. Existing IDs, seats and owner links are retained.

tables.name: review-images
tables.description: RETIRED: unused predecessor metadata table, NOT the Storage review-images bucket. Storage files must remain untouched.

tables.name: reviews
tables.description: ACTIVE: public review text; ownership and deletion-token hash are server-only. Anonymous reviews are not inferred as account-owned.

tables.name: seat_status
tables.description: RETIRED: predecessor seats linked to bookings; existing records retained. Current seats derive from musical-specific bookings.

tables.name: toctoc_bookings
tables.description: ACTIVE: toctoc reservations. Existing IDs, seats and owner links are retained.

constraints.name: fan_visits_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: arte_musical_tickets_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: dead_poets_society_bookings_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: performance_settings_period_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (musical_id) REFERENCES arte_musical_application_period(musical_name) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: presale_access_keys_time_range
constraints.definition: CHECK (((starts_at IS NULL) OR (ends_at IS NULL) OR (starts_at <= ends_at)))

constraints.name: profiles_completed_fields
constraints.definition: CHECK (((profile_completed_at IS NULL) OR ((username IS NOT NULL) AND (display_name IS NOT NULL) AND (student_id IS NOT NULL) AND (contact_number IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: rent_bookings_user_id_fkey

constraints.name: reviews_user_id_fkey

constraints.name: toctoc_bookings_user_id_fkey
